head: WORKTREE
summary: Reserve-funds consumer is sound: inbox, ledger transaction and reply share one transaction; refusals roll back the attempt and are recorded in a second transaction; redelivery tested end to end over counters. Only a stale ADR sentence remains.

acceptance_criteria.evidence: ReserveFundsIT#redeliveredReserveFundsHasNoSecondEffect (counters, transactions, single inbox row, single reply); ReserveFundsServiceTest#redeliveredCommandChangesNothing, #refusalIsRecordedSoItsRedeliveryRepliesNothing; InboxIT

Lazy idempotent provisioning: AccountId.paymentsInTransit (UUID v3), AccountPersistenceAdapter.saveIfAbsent ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, Account.paymentsInTransit LIABILITY; exercised by ReserveFundsIT. Decision still to be recorded in ADR 0012 (see finding).
messaging-support Inbox + create-processed-messages.sql, ledger changeset 0006; InboxIT rejects use outside a transaction; firstDelivery called inside the use-case transaction
changeset 0005-create-outbox-messages, OutboxConfiguration, ReservationRepliesOutboxAdapter writes FundsReserved/ReservationRefused via OutboxWriter in the same transaction

findings.description: ADR 0012 still says the provisioning mechanism 'is decided by the first task that needs it (T-027)'. T-027 decided it (lazy idempotent insert with a deterministic id per currency) but the ADR was not updated.
findings.suggestion: Replace the sentence with the decision: deterministic UUID v3 id per currency, inserted with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING inside the reservation transaction.
findings.rule: Definition of done: docs/ADR updated if a decision changed

findings.description: A malformed message (non-UUID debtor id, non-positive or bad currency) throws from the mapper/command constructor and will be redelivered forever until T-031 adds DLT. Acceptable per scope, but not noted in code.
findings.suggestion: Add a short comment or tracking note pointing to T-031.
